title: CredentialRef
description: Reference to a credential stored in Account Again's secret store. ABSOLUTE RULE: NO raw API key, NO password, NO private key material, NO OAuth refresh token, NO secret value in this contract. References only. Reconciled in E4.1 against Account Again's actual v1.0/E4-C runtime (account_again/models/credential_reference.py) — pre-freeze v2.1.0 correction.

credentialRef.description: Opaque reference to the credential. NOT the credential value.

tenantId.description: Owning tenant. Every credential reference is tenant-scoped in the runtime — resolution requests must supply a matching tenantId or are rejected (E4.1 §19, DENY_TENANT_MISMATCH).

ownerAccountId.description: Account Again account that owns this credential, if owned by a specific human account rather than the tenant as a whole. Legitimately null for tenant-level/service credentials — RUNTIME_CORRECT_SCHEMA_WRONG finding from E4.1: the prior schema incorrectly required this field.

provider.description: Provider this credential is for (e.g., openai, anthropic, ollama-is-never-referenced-here-since-it-needs-no-credential).

secretStoreType.description: Metadata about the secret store backing this reference (NOT the secret). Flat field in the runtime — RUNTIME_CORRECT_SCHEMA_WRONG finding from E4.1: the prior schema nested this under secretStoreRef.storeType, which the API never produced.

secretStoreReference.description: Opaque path/key within the secret store. Flat field (see secretStoreType note).

rotatedAt.description: Timestamp of last rotation, if any. Missing from the prior schema despite being a real runtime field.

revokedAt.description: Timestamp of revocation, if REVOKED. Missing from the prior schema despite being a real runtime field.
